works.body:
Hello there,
Thank you for the appeal. I'd be happy for you to draw either Sylphia or Seo, up to you. If you choose Seo, I would like to request that you draw her with her fairy companion, Alisa.
Sylphia is a former underground colosseum fighter, now mercenary. She's normally very laid back but is very wild when in combat as she finds combat very thrilling.
Seo is runaway high royalty who became a gyaru because she found gyarus very interesting. Very self sufficient despite being royalty, she loves to cook and clean for herself. Alisa is a lazy and introverted NEET mangaka. Always late with her manga.
Feel free to draw them however you wish! I look forward to your work!

Sylphia: https://photos.app.goo.gl/mftS8tnNgCQt2u7M8
Seo & Alisa: https://photos.app.goo.gl/5nG89M2fYF6M4wmc9
